summary: Compiles the public Plugin Manager tool binaries explicitly for each target architecture and adds an amd64/arm64 build gate before release.
userImpact: Connected and air-gapped plugin installation images can be published for both amd64 and arm64 without relying on native-only Go installation behavior.
Pull requests now exercise the same cross-compilation path used by protected multi-architecture publication through an isolated BuildKit container builder.

instructions: Use plugin installer 0.2.2, Plugin Manager 0.1.2, and the matching 0.2.2 and 0.1.2 Helm charts; the failed v0.15.2 toolchain run did not produce a qualified release receipt.

security: The target-architecture binaries retain the patched Go, gRPC, x/mod, and x/text dependency floors introduced in v0.15.2.
Both amd64 and arm64 tool stages must build successfully in an isolated Docker container builder before the native runtime images are scanned and a protected publication may start.
documentation: The generated release guide records the replacement toolchain versions and the unqualified v0.15.2 publication attempt.
knownLimitations: The failed v0.15.2 toolchain workflow stopped before publishing images, charts, signatures, attestations, or an offline receipt.
rollback: Keep the currently qualified plugin toolchain installed until the 0.2.2/0.1.2 replacement receipt has been verified.
validation: PR-gated amd64 and arm64 ORAS/Cosign cross-compilation
Native production image execution and Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL scans
Protected multi-architecture image, chart, signature, provenance, and offline-bundle qualification
